privacy: Every image and OCR response in these model experiments is generated from invented UI fixtures; no target captures were read.

environment.requests: sequential; loaded instance parallel capacity4 but one client request at a time

interpretation.first_is_not_always_cold: First means first request within a cell; separate initial first-after-loading observations are identified above/in diagnostic cells.
interpretation.prompt_variants: Qwen initial dashboard/modal prompt was ambiguous. Explicit mode prompt is separately labeled; these cells do not give controlled cross-model accuracy rankings.
interpretation.holo_channel: All Holo extracted objects were in reasoning_content; ordinary final content was empty. Correct counts using parsed include this diagnostic channel adapter; final_content_correct does not.
interpretation.binary: Four changed and four identical warm image pairs at960 width; simple synthetic imagery without capture noise.
interpretation.ocr: Grayscale, 2xnearest, English PSM6/OEM3. Includes preprocessing and feeds PNG; current MCP uses PGM. Missing blue button means not equivalent state extraction.
interpretation.accuracy: Exact four-field object equality on simple generated fixtures. Does not validate general GUI parsing or coordinates.
interpretation.latency: Wall-clock HTTP requests; fixture generation, JPEG encoding and data-URL construction excluded. No controller latency or physical KVM-to-model pipeline measured.
